metadata.name: Open Responses conformance matrix
metadata.last_verified_test_summary: 31 unit/integration tests passed; 12/12 Open Responses compliance tests passed (6 gpt-5.4-mini + 6 claude-haiku-4.5)

status_legend.implemented: Requirement is implemented and backed by code evidence and/or tests.
status_legend.partial: Some support exists, but behavior is limited, incomplete, or only works for a subset of models.
status_legend.not_implemented: The requirement is not meaningfully implemented yet.
status_legend.out_of_scope: Intentional deviation for this local-proxy product shape.

metadata.scope_note: This file tracks Open Responses spec coverage. Project-specific compatibility checks live under adjacent_checks and are not counted as spec conformance.

spec_requirements.requirement: Accept JSON request bodies and return application/json for non-streaming responses.
spec_requirements.spec_reference: HTTP Requests / HTTP Request Bodies; HTTP Responses / HTTP Response Bodies
spec_requirements.notes: ASP.NET Core model binding handles JSON request parsing. Non-streaming responses are returned as application/json.

spec_requirements.requirement: Require an Authorization header from the client.
spec_requirements.notes: The proxy is intentionally local-first and does not authenticate downstream clients. SDK examples use an unused API key value.
spec_requirements.next_action: If strict spec conformance becomes a goal, add optional local auth enforcement without breaking the current single-user local-proxy workflow.

spec_requirements.requirement: When streaming, return text/event-stream, emit semantic events whose event field matches the body type, and terminate with [DONE].
spec_requirements.spec_reference: Streaming HTTP Responses; Streaming / Delta Events; Streaming / State Machine events
spec_requirements.notes: The translated and native streaming paths follow the semantic event pattern with \n line endings, sequence_number on all events, logprobs on content/text events, and terminal [DONE] marker. SSE serialization uses explicit \n (not AppendLine) for cross-platform compatibility.

spec_requirements.requirement: Return the canonical response envelope with id, object, created_at, status, model, output, and usage.
spec_requirements.notes: Response envelope now includes all 31 spec-required fields (20 non-nullable with defaults, 11 nullable with JsonIgnoreCondition.Never). Both native passthrough and translated paths produce spec-compliant envelopes validated by the Open Responses compliance suite.

spec_requirements.requirement: Support the standard message, function_call, and function_call_output item types with required top-level fields.
spec_requirements.spec_reference: Items are polymorphic; Required item fields
spec_requirements.notes: The proxy has concrete models for these item types and uses them in both translated responses and streaming.

spec_requirements.requirement: Support reasoning items, including content, summary, and encrypted_content where available.
spec_requirements.notes: The data model contains reasoning and summary_text types, but the proxy does not currently map or stream reasoning output from upstream providers.
spec_requirements.next_action: Add non-streaming and streaming reasoning coverage, then map any upstream reasoning-capable models into canonical reasoning items.

spec_requirements.requirement: Model response and item lifecycle with in_progress, completed, failed, and incomplete states, including incomplete_details when relevant.
spec_requirements.spec_reference: Items are state machines; State machines
spec_requirements.notes: Translated chat-completions now populate incomplete_details for length-truncated responses, emit response.incomplete as the terminal state-machine event, and keep only the final output item in the incomplete state while earlier items remain completed. Failed streaming continues to emit response.failed.

spec_requirements.requirement: Stream message text through output_item.added, content_part.added, output_text.delta, output_text.done, content_part.done, output_item.done, and response.completed.
spec_requirements.spec_reference: Items are streamable; Streaming / Delta Events
spec_requirements.notes: All streaming text events include logprobs arrays and sequence_number. Both translated (chat-completions) and native paths validated by compliance suite.

spec_requirements.requirement: Support function tools, tool_choice modes (auto, required, none, forced function), and function_call_output round-trips.
spec_requirements.notes: Function tools are currently the supported tool surface across both translated and streaming flows.

spec_requirements.requirement: Treat allowed_tools as a hard execution constraint, not just a prompt hint.
spec_requirements.notes: The proxy filters the visible tool list before sending translated chat-completions requests. It does not yet verify that returned tool calls remain inside the allowed subset, and native /responses passthrough relies on upstream enforcement.
spec_requirements.next_action: Add server-side validation for returned tool calls and explicit tests for native and translated enforcement paths.

spec_requirements.requirement: Support the spec's user content unions cleanly, including structured text parts and future multimodal inputs.
spec_requirements.spec_reference: Content; User Content vs Model Content
spec_requirements.notes: The proxy supports string input, message objects, arrays of messages, function_call, function_call_output, and image_url content parts. The image-input compliance test passes. Audio/video modalities are not modeled or translated.
spec_requirements.next_action: Add explicit input unions for audio/video content types, or reject unsupported modalities with precise errors.

spec_requirements.requirement: Honor previous_response_id by rehydrating prior input and output before appending new input.
spec_requirements.notes: The field exists and is passed through to native /responses providers. The proxy does not persist prior response state and therefore cannot emulate these semantics for translated chat-completions-only models.
spec_requirements.next_action: Persist response transcripts locally or surface capability metadata that makes the native-only limitation explicit.

spec_requirements.requirement: Support truncation control, including auto and disabled semantics.
spec_requirements.notes: The truncation field is accepted on requests, forwarded to native providers, and echoed back in responses (defaults to 'disabled'). Actual truncation enforcement for translated models is not implemented.
spec_requirements.next_action: Implement auto-truncation logic for translated chat-completions models.

spec_requirements.requirement: Support the service_tier hint where the implementation chooses to expose it.
spec_requirements.notes: The service_tier field is accepted on requests, forwarded to native providers, and echoed in responses with a default of 'default'. Validated by compliance suite.

spec_requirements.requirement: Return a structured error envelope with message, type, code, and param, and align status-to-type mapping with the spec.
spec_requirements.notes: The envelope shape is solid. The main gap is taxonomy alignment: the implementation still uses the OpenAI-style invalid_request_error label for many 4xx failures, while the current Open Responses spec text also describes invalid_request. This should stay tracked explicitly until the target taxonomy is locked.
spec_requirements.next_action: Normalize error type naming once the project decides whether it is targeting strict Open Responses labels or OpenAI-compatible labels where the two diverge.

spec_requirements.requirement: Preserve or safely tolerate provider-prefixed extension item and event types.
spec_requirements.spec_reference: Items are extensible; Extending Items; Extending streaming events
spec_requirements.notes: Native streaming passthrough can carry upstream events unchanged, but non-stream normalization and canonical deserialization only know the built-in item/content types. Unknown item types are not yet preserved as opaque extension records.
spec_requirements.next_action: Add opaque extension item/event models or an extension-preserving fallback path for native responses payloads.

spec_requirements.requirement: Run the official Open Responses acceptance tests and record pass/fail coverage.
spec_requirements.notes: 12/12 compliance tests pass manually (6 gpt-5.4-mini native + 6 claude-haiku-4.5 translated). Process is documented but not yet wired into CI.
spec_requirements.next_action: Wire the compliance tests into CI with both model targets and auto-update this matrix.

adjacent_checks.notes: /v1/models is not an Open Responses conformance signal by itself, but it is the current way this project exposes proxy-vs-upstream capability metadata.
This verifies the current OpenAI .NET SDK story over a real Kestrel socket.
